nodes.label: Piper TTS Pipeline
nodes.rationale: VITS ONNX architecture running >10x real-time on ARM64 with 30-60MB footprints, routing directly to ALSA/PipeWire sink.

nodes.label: PipeWire Audio Server Subsystem
nodes.rationale: Prevents device-locking collisions between background recording daemon and WPE WebKit playback.

nodes.label: Semantic Intent Router & Distractor Suppression
nodes.rationale: Scores cosine similarity against MiniLM embeddings with OOD distractor anchors and margin thresholding to reject conversational chatter quietly.

nodes.label: Silero VAD & Energy Gating
nodes.rationale: RMS floor drops signals below -42 dBFS; Silero VAD evaluates 30ms chunks to reject distant chatter before ASR decoding.

nodes.label: Wake-Word Detector
nodes.rationale: Runs openWakeWord or sherpa-onnx-kws against VAD-cleared audio buffers (<3% CPU on Cortex-A53) to gate ASR capture windows.

nodes.label: Annotation Dictation Mode
nodes.rationale: Isolates spoken dictation into drafts for approval; words spoken during dictation cannot invoke commands.

nodes.label: Native Voice Daemon Architecture
nodes.rationale: Native C++ daemon isolated outside WebKit so renderer reloads do not orphan pending commands and voice faults do not impede touch.

nodes.label: WebRTC APM AEC3 Echo Processing
nodes.rationale: Processes 10ms blocks to provide acoustic echo cancellation, noise suppression, and speaker render reference.

nodes.label: Closed-Loop Synthetic Acoustic Benchmark Harness
nodes.rationale: Eliminates variable and non-reproducible manual microphone testing by synthesizing speech via Kokoro TTS, applying perturbations, and scoring ASR.

nodes.label: Two-Pass Speech Recognition Pipeline
nodes.rationale: 1st pass streaming ASR (Nemotron-3.5/Kroko) delivers instant partials; 2nd pass offline Parakeet Ultra refines drafts with punctuation and casing.

nodes.label: Two-Tier Test Suite Architecture
nodes.rationale: Balances fast 15-20s developer feedback in CI (Tier 1) with deep 50-100+ clip acoustic validation (Tier 2).

nodes.label: Dual Audio Input Architecture
nodes.rationale: Supports Web UI mic for browser testing, Host Go mic for embedded WPE appliances without mic access, and WAV injection for deterministic tests.

nodes.label: Dual-Purpose Speech Recognition
nodes.rationale: Decouples command execution state machine from continuous dictation draft review to prevent accidental trigger of commands.

nodes.label: Circular Pre-roll Ring Buffer
nodes.rationale: Retains 1.0s of audio to prepend onto ASR stream upon wake-word trigger so post-wake words are never lost.

nodes.label: Edge Tuning & CPU Pinning
nodes.rationale: Pins WPE to cores 0-2 and Voice Daemon to core 3; sets PipeWire quantum to 512 samples; INT8/FP16 models kept under 200MB.

nodes.label: Native Daemon Bridge Pattern
nodes.rationale: Running real-time neural speech models inside WPE WebKit via WebAssembly/WebGPU introduces high memory and GC pauses; native daemon directly accesses host audio and ONNX runtimes.

nodes.label: Half-Duplex Echo Control Policy
nodes.rationale: Inhibit command recognition during device speech to prevent self-triggering before validating AEC double-talk.

nodes.label: Intent Ranking & Rejection Recipe
nodes.rationale: Small grammar and negation checks first; weighted semantic scoring with MiniLM; calibrated threshold and margin separation.

nodes.label: Dual Engine Strategy (Live Sherpa vs Simulator)
nodes.norm_label: dual engine strategy (live sherpa vs simulator)
nodes.rationale: Enables immediate out-of-the-box development and testing without requiring multi-gigabyte neural weight downloads or C++ compilers.

nodes.label: Kokoro FP16 Variant
nodes.rationale: Halves RAM usage (~163MB) and runs ~4-5x faster than INT8 on x86 CPUs by avoiding dynamic quantization overhead on AdaIN layers.

nodes.label: Kokoro INT8 Variant
nodes.rationale: Quantized weights down to ~114MB sharing lexicons with FP32, optimized for mobile/ARM targets.

nodes.label: VoxLab Test Bench
nodes.rationale: Engineering test bench for voice input and output architectures across web runtimes on Windows and Linux.

nodes.label: VoxLab App Specification
nodes.rationale: Engineering test bench to develop and test voice input and voice output architectures for web applications using Go v1.27 backend and plain HTML+JS UI.

nodes.label: Tier 2 Acoustic Matrix Findings
nodes.rationale: Achieves 92/104 (88.5%) pass rate above the 80% bar after re-baselining with anti-aliased sinc resampler, resolving Kokoro language prefixing.

nodes.label: Persistent Warm TTS Engine
nodes.rationale: Binds to sherpa-onnx-c-api.dll in RAM to eliminate ~1.8-2.0s process startup and disk read overhead per utterance.

nodes.label: DSP Preprocessing Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Combines -42 dBFS RMS noise floor gate, 80Hz high-pass filter, software AGC, and half-duplex echo latch to sanitize incoming speech.

nodes.label: Dual Engine Mode
nodes.rationale: Provides zero-dependency Go simulator for fast development and persistent resident Sherpa-ONNX daemons for neural inference.

nodes.label: Half-Duplex Echo Gate
nodes.rationale: Suppresses microphone input during speech playback to prevent self-triggering feedback loops.

nodes.label: Pre-roll Ring Buffer
nodes.rationale: 1.0s circular buffer preserving initial syllables and early words immediately preceding or following wake-word detection.

nodes.label: Hann-Windowed Sinc Resampler
nodes.rationale: Anti-aliased downsampler from 24 kHz to 16 kHz to eliminate acoustic distortion in Kokoro evaluation audio.

nodes.label: CJK Hallucination Guard
nodes.rationale: Prevents English offline models from overwriting native Hanzi streaming transcripts.

nodes.label: Domain Term Correction Plan
nodes.rationale: List-based post-correction chosen over Sherpa hotwords because hotwords corrupted phrases without bpe.vocab on Parakeet TDT v2, and MedASR was rejected.

nodes.label: Language Handling Policy
nodes.rationale: Server ASR kept on auto-detect because sherpa-onnx-online-websocket-server lacks language options and clean speech gains nothing from hints.
